title: Fil-C: Garbage In, Memory Safety Out [video]
summary: A technical presentation on Fil-C, a language or tool focused on achieving memory safety even with garbage or invalid inputs, likely through compile-time checks or runtime guarantees.
problem_solved: Provides memory safety guarantees for code that may receive invalid or garbage input, eliminating common memory vulnerabilities like buffer overflows and use-after-free.
why_valuable: Offers a practical approach to building memory-safe systems without sacrificing the performance and control of low-level languages like C, bridging the gap between safety and efficiency.
